---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement to an existing project
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["type:feature"]
---

## Problem
What user or operational problem does this solve?

## Proposed behavior
Describe the desired outcome.

## Existing alternatives
Which existing tools or workflows have you evaluated?

## Acceptance criteria
List observable, testable outcomes.

## Security and operational considerations
Describe permissions, side effects, failure behavior and audit needs.

## AWS and cost considerations
List expected services and cost implications, if known. Do not provision infrastructure as part of an issue.
